Subject: SIG intake: initial sections + deadline (10/20)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for agreeing to take the lead on the SIG. Attached is the SIG spreadsheet with our initial mapping and a short evidence matrix we put together from the questionnaire. Our procurement team has requested completion of all narrative answers and supporting evidence by EOD 2026-10-20 so we can progress to legal review the following week.

Key asks:
- Owner for each SIG section (name + backup)
- Expected evidence items (docs, screenshots, audit logs) or a note if item is not applicable
- Any SOC 2 artifacts or reports you can share instead of writing a narrative

We know this is tight — if some sections need more time, please flag them with a new deadline and we'll try to be flexible. I've attached: SIG_Request_20261012.xlsx (questionnaire) and an evidence matrix example.

Thanks,
Lauren

Hi Lauren —

Received, thank you. I'm looping in the owners from product, security, and compliance so we can triage and assign sections today. Quick plan below:

1) Triage session (internal): 2026-10-12 11:30 PT — 30m to review spreadsheet and call out obvious dependencies.
2) Assignment: we'll map primary/backup owners and produce an evidence tracker by EOD 10/12.
3) Target: draft responses + evidence pointers by 10/16 so we can iterate internally before your 10/20 deadline.

For transparency: we may need to provide SOC 2 System Description and the latest SOC 2 report under NDA; Neha will confirm availability. Also, a few infra-level screenshots (network controls, VPC peering page) will require screenshots from infra team — Karthik will coordinate.

If that timeline works, I'll run the triage now and follow up with the owner roster and a shared Drive link for evidence collection.
